newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends slightly easier to flat.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends slightly easier to flat.

text.p: 1605 GMT - The Swiss franc closed weaker to barely changed as the dollar firmed somewhat on broad European support and the mark eased under the U.S. unit. * The dollar closed at 1.4742/4748 Swiss francs vs opening 1.4720/4730, which was unchanged from Monday's close. * The mark ended at 86.42/44 centimes, unchanged from prior close and down from opening 86.52/54.

* Traders said dollar was still facing potential slide vs Swiss franc, with next test point at 1.4700. Overnight range seen at 1.4650/4750. * Mark/Swiss supported at 86.35 short-term, next point down at 86.15, then cpuld go to 85.80/90, -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
